mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATCH_FILE (ATCH_FILE_ID, FILE_SN, STRE_FILE_NM, ORIGNL_FILE_NM, FILE_EXTSN, FILE_SIZE) VALUES (#{atchFileId}, #{fileSn}, #{streFileNm}, #{orignlFileNm}, #{fileExtsn}, #{fileSize})
